paper_title: Bounds on Axions-Like Particles Shining in the Ultra-Violet
notes: ALP decay into two photons search using HST FUV archival spectra of dSphs (UMi, Draco) and clusters (Virgo, Fornax), assuming ALP=DM. Combined 95% C.L. limit excludes g_agamma > ~1e-12 GeV^-1 over 14.4-22.2 eV, reaching 2e-13 for some masses. Only the overall ~1e-12 GeV^-1 exclusion level is quoted numerically in the text; the detailed mass-dependent curve is only shown in Fig.3 and cannot be read precisely. Data points here approximate the stated flat ~1e-12 GeV^-1 bound across the mass range. Local DM density not applicable (D-factors from halo profiles used instead). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 5))
